services.title: Services and fees
services.heading: Choose the level of support needed for your event

items.name: Coordinate an existing event
items.text: You have the venue and main suppliers booked. We bring the arrangements together so timings, arrivals and handovers are clear before guests arrive.
points: One venue and date, with up to four external suppliers
Planning handover, supplier coordination and a run sheet
On-site lead for up to six hours, preparation included

items.when: You need the evening put together
items.name: Plan and manage a private evening
items.text: For a birthday, anniversary or private gathering that needs a plan as well as someone to run it.
points: An agreed proposal, budget and schedule, with one site visit
On-site lead for up to eight hours

items.when: A commissioned evening for your venue
items.name: Produce a venue-led evening
items.text: A restaurant, hotel or hospitality venue commissions a distinctive evening for a defined audience. We develop the concept and lead the delivery.
points: Concept, event schedule and production planning
Entertainment and supplier management, venue team briefing
On-site lead; hours and supplier scope set in the proposal

items.name: Plan a more complex event
items.text: Multiple sites or days, arrival and transport arrangements, additional suppliers or specialist crew, or active outings with specialist providers.
points: Logistics and staffing defined before the work is priced

services.note: These fee guides cover our professional work only. Venue, hospitality, entertainment and other supplier costs sit in a separate event budget. The written proposal confirms the fee, tax treatment and included scope.

budget.heading: What your budget covers
items: Planning, coordination and event management, including the preparation and on-site time stated in the proposal.
Venue hire, food and drink, performers, equipment, crew, transport, permits and music rights, unless expressly included.
The host or venue normally contracts and pays suppliers directly; we set out the arrangement for each one.

explore.heading: Explore the idea first
explore.text: A free 15–20 minute fit call helps establish the right service. For a feasibility review before commissioning an event, a limited advisory engagement covers 2–4 agreed hours of preparation, discussion and written next steps.

venues.title: Venue partnerships
venues.heading: Built around your audience and your space
venues.lead: We build the evening around your audience, your space and the way your hospitality team operates.
items: We agree who the event is for, what makes it worth attending and how it fits your venue: a rooftop aperitivo, dinner with live music, a tasting or a company social. These are examples to develop together.
For a house event, the venue commissions YMG against a written event order: the concept, deliverables, fee, dates and the named people responsible for decisions.
Build a series when the format fits
Repeat dates can use a nonexclusive framework with an event order for each date. Series pricing reflects committed dates and reusable planning; an unconfirmed calendar is quoted event by event.
venues.agreeHeading: Agreed in writing before promotion begins
agree: Who pays YMG, who approves the budget and who is the event organizer.
Who contracts entertainment and suppliers, and who provides venue staff, access and hospitality.
Who promotes the event, sells tickets, handles guests and refunds, and owns ticket and bar revenue.
Who covers venue suitability, capacity, safety, permits, insurance and music rights.
How cancellation, postponement and committed supplier costs are handled.
venues.economics: The venue’s event budget covers hospitality and production costs alongside YMG’s fee; if ticket income is part of the plan, we review the assumptions together. Attendance and revenue are not guaranteed. Any revenue share has an agreed calculation, deductions, settlement date and supporting records. Any separate referral commission is disclosed, including who pays it.

delivery.title: Delivery and budgets
delivery.heading: Clear decisions, coordinated delivery
items: We confirm the proposal, responsibilities and key dates, prepare the schedule and supplier handovers, then check access, setup, guest arrival, service timings and any weather alternative.
Your on-site lead coordinates the agreed suppliers and venue contacts, follows the run sheet and manages changes within the agreed authority. A short debrief records open actions.
The proposal names the budget approver, payment milestones, any booking payment, cancellation terms and quote validity. Added work and cost are agreed in writing before they are incurred.
delivery.quote: Guest numbers, supplier load, setup windows, access, travel and on-site hours. Ligurian locations are assessed on their actual logistics. Guest communication, ticketing, photography and promotional work are included only when specified.

contact.heading: Tell us what you are planning
contact.lead: A short brief is enough to begin. We will help identify the level of support that fits your event.
paths: Share the occasion, what you have already booked and the work you would like to hand over. After the fit call, we recommend a service and prepare a defined proposal.
Tell us about your space, audience and proposed date, with your hospitality offer and commercial objective. We can assess a single evening or discuss a committed series.
checklist: The occasion or idea, preferred date and approximate guest count
The venue or preferred area, and any suppliers already booked
Your total budget, including an allowance for YMG’s fee
What you want YMG to manage, and any access or timing constraints
contact.checklistNote: Not every detail needs to be settled before we speak.
contact.founderBio: Based in Genova and originally from the USA, Dante is the founder of YMG Events. His experience spans community gatherings, music events and international experiences.
